import unittest
import handover_notes as app

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_continuations(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.unfold_notes('pump stopped\n  valve closed'), ['pump stopped valve closed'])
        self.assertEqual(app.unfold_notes('A\r\n\tB\r\n  C\r\nD\n E'), ['A B C', 'D E'])
        self.assertEqual(app.unfold_notes('A  x\n  B  y  '), ['A  x B  y'])
    def test_blank_and_orphan(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.unfold_notes('A\n\n  B\n \nC'), ['A B', 'C'])
        self.assertEqual(app.unfold_notes(' \t\n'), [])
        self.assertEqual(app.unfold_notes('A\nB'), ['A', 'B'])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            app.unfold_notes('\n  orphan')

    def test_additional_behavior(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.unfold_notes('pump  east\n\tvalve closed\n\n  ready'), ['pump  east valve closed ready'])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

# handover-note-folding

行为约定：
unfold_notes(text) 返回交接记录字符串列表。非空且不以空格或制表符开头的行开启一条记录；以空格或制表符开头的非空行延续上一条，使用一个空格连接其 strip() 后的内容。各行两端空白去除，空白行忽略，不结束上一条记录。没有上一条记录的延续行抛 ValueError。输入使用 LF 或 CRLF。

验证命令：`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`。
只使用 Python 3.12 标准库，保持接口，不修改 tests/。
